x: The Editor wishes to thank Gwen Couzens and Sally Lucas for their assistance in typing the June and September issues of "The Belgravian" and, at the same time, extends a welcome to any budding journalist who would like to co-operate in the production of future gazettes.
Our band of willing typists grows and the typescript for this edition was prepared by Sally Lucas and Margaret North to whom the Editor is eternally grateful.
